pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Thullanandā bhikkhunī rathiyāya pi byūhe pi siṅghāṭake pi purisena saddhiṃ eken' ekā santiṭṭhati pi sallapati pi nikaṇṇikaṃ pi jappeti dutiyikaṃ pi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā rathiyāya pi . . . santiṭṭhissati pi sallapissati pi nikaṇṇikaṃ pi jappissati dutiyikaṃ pi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojessatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī rathiyāya pi . . . uyyojetīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī rathiyāya pi . . . uyyojessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī rathiyāya vā byūhe vā siṅghāṭake vā purisena saddhiṃ eken' ekā santiṭṭheyya vā sallapeyya vā nikaṇṇikaṃ vā jappeyya dutiyikaṃ vā bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.8: yen' eva pavisanti ten' eva nikkhamanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.12: manussapuriso na yakkho na peto na tiracchānagato viññū paṭibalo santiṭṭhituṃ sallapituṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.16: puriso c' eva hoti bhikkhunī ca.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.24: anācāraṃ ācaritukāmā dutiyikaṃ pi bhikkhuniṃ uyyojeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.1.25: dassanupacāraṃ vā savanupacāraṃ vā vijahantiyā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.2.1: hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā santiṭṭhati vā sallapati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc14:2.2.2: yakkhena vā petena vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatamanussaviggahena vā saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati vā sallapati vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||1||
